correctness.rationale: Fano construction enumerates exactly 28 nonline triples and 42 disjointness edges; BFS and integer matrix algebra prove all distance-polynomial identities and adjacency eigenvalue factors. Five eigenspaces including constants have multiplicities 1,8,7,6,6. The analytic proof bounds three nonconstant powered-distance eigenvalue branches below zero for exponents 0..1, proves the fourth branch has a unique root by an everywhere-positive second derivative and positive first derivative at 0, and then applies Schoenberg and centered Gram rank. The standalone checker was run successfully from the actual new package directory. Numerical tests are not used to infer all real exponents.

value.rationale: For a canonical primitive 28-vertex distance-transitive graph, the exact maximal negative-type exponent is a natural metric and kernel-positivity invariant motivated by known finite-metric negative-type theory. Its nontrivial radical-exponential root, unique harmonic obstruction, and drop in critical Euclidean embedding dimension from 27 to 21 are mathematically meaningful, exact, and not equivalent to merely recalling the published adjacency spectrum. No broader graph-family extension is claimed.
